name: Rasa Juknevičienė - § 8 - Am 20
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Georgia
part_text: 8. Respects the outcome of the parliamentary elections of 26 October 2024 as an expression of the democratic will of the Georgian people; underlines the importance of all political forces working within the constitutional framework to ensure political stability and the proper functioning of democratic institutions;
